request.description:
## Get User Favorites

This endpoint retrieves a list of favorites associated with the user's profile.

### Request

- **Method**: `GET`
    
- **Endpoint**: `http://localhost:8000/api/v1/profile/favorites`
    

### Response

Upon a successful request, the server will respond with a status code of `200` and a JSON object containing the following structure:

- **data**: An array of favorite items, where each item includes:
    
    - `id`: Unique identifier for the favorite item.
        
    - `favoritable_type`: The type of the item that is favorited.
        
    - `favoritable_id`: The identifier of the favorited item.
        
    - `favoritable`: An object containing:
        
        - `id`: Unique identifier of the favoritable item.
            
        - `title`: Title of the favoritable item.
            
        - `url`: URL of the favoritable item.
            
    - `created_at`: Timestamp of when the favorite was created.
        
- **links**: Pagination links for navigating through the results, including:
    
    - `first`: URL to the first page.
        
    - `last`: URL to the last page.
        
    - `prev`: URL to the previous page (null if there is no previous page).
        
    - `next`: URL to the next page (null if there is no next page).
        
- **meta**: Metadata about the response, including:
    
    - `current_page`: The current page number.
        
    - `from`: The starting index of the current page.
        
    - `last_page`: The total number of pages available.
        
    - `links`: An array of pagination links.
        
    - `path`: The path for the current request.
        
    - `per_page`: The number of items per page.
        
    - `to`: The ending index of the current page.
        
    - `total`: The total number of favorite items.
        

This endpoint is useful for users to view their saved favorite items in a structured format.

### DELETE /api/v1/profile/favorites/{id}

This endpoint allows users to remove a specific favorite item from their profile by providing the unique identifier of the favorite item.

#### Request Parameters

- **id** (path parameter): The unique identifier of the favorite item to be deleted. In this example, the ID is `4`.
    

#### Expected Response

- **Status Code**: `200 OK`
    
- **Content-Type**: `application/json`
    
- **Response Body**:
    
    - `status`: A string indicating the status of the operation.
        
    - `message`: A string providing additional information about the operation.
        
    - `data`: This will be `null` as the response does not return any data upon successful deletion.
        

#### Notes

- Ensure that the ID provided in the request corresponds to an existing favorite item; otherwise, the operation may fail.
    
- This operation is idempotent, meaning that calling it multiple times with the same ID will have the same effect as calling it once.
